title: Texas man accused of posing as veteran to win $1.6m contracts, supply fake gear
description: Marcelo Fascino, a 24-year-old from San Antonio, Texas, stands accused of securing more than $1.6 million in federal contracts by deceitfully claiming his business was owned by veterans. He allegedly misrepresented his military background, impersonated government officials, and manipulated suppliers to stifle competition. Furthermore, investigators found he sold counterfeit military gear, mislabeling it as American-made but failing to meet specifications. He faces several charges as the investigation proceeds.

title: Beverly Hills penthouse sells for $21M, with rooftop pool and $18,740 monthly dues
description: In a stunning real estate move, a penthouse in Beverly Hills has shattered local records by selling for $21 million within just 10 days of listing. Initially priced at $27.5 million, the luxe property ultimately changed hands for 24% less, showcasing its many high-end amenities and hotel-style services for residents. The fortunate buyer also saved over $1 million in transfer taxes by opting for Beverly Hills over Los Angeles.

title: France to take Rohingya genocide row to UN after Myanmar rejects ICJ verdict

France's foreign ministry plans to seek a UN Security Council meeting in response to Myanmar's refusal. Additionally, Article 94 of the UN charter obligates all member states to comply with ICJ decisions. The Gambia can also approach the Security Council regarding Myanmar's non-compliance with the ruling.

He emphasized the necessity of dialogue among various cultures. The forum, which was kicked off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, seeks to illuminate India's diverse civilizational heritage via displays and archaeological findings.

The attack is significant due to the vessel's military logistics links and ongoing tensions in the region.

His goal is to secure a lasting pact that prevents Iran from developing nuclear capabilities.

title: 'Don't dislike BJP': Shehzad on quitting politics, says rift with brother ideological
description: Shehzad Poonawalla clarified that his exit from active politics is not due to dislike for the BJP. He expressed his ongoing support for Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other BJP leaders. Differences with his brother Tehseen Poonawalla were framed as a clash of principles rather than personal issues. Shehzad emphasized that every person in India should identify as Hindu.

title: US lawmaker turns up heat on Musk over Ukraine Starshield disruptions
description: US Representative Jim Himes has warned SpaceX about potential funding cuts if it does not clarify its actions regarding Ukraine. The company faced scrutiny over its restrictions on satellite communications that impacted Ukraine's military operations. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported systematic disruptions affecting military technology amid ongoing conflict. Disagreements over who controls the Starshield system have arisen among government officials and SpaceX.

'Goondaism isn't a bug': BJP, BRS attack Congress over Meta office vandalism
description: Youth Congress workers caused a commotion at the Meta office in Hyderabad, protesting account suspensions affecting their leaders. This vandalism was denounced by leaders from both the BJP and BRS, who claimed it jeopardized the city's business-friendly image. N Ramchander Rao, president of Telangana BJP, criticized Congress for promoting such destructive behavior. Meanwhile, K T Rama Rao of BRS articulated that such incidents erode trust in companies like Meta.

title: Iran claims it hit F-16 jet over Gulf, forced emergency landing; US denies attack
description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps has claimed to have inflicted damage on a US F-16 fighter jet, allegedly leading to its emergency landing in the Gulf. However, the US Central Command has firmly dismissed these assertions, labeling them as untrue. They assured that all American aircraft in the Middle East are secure and accounted for, highlighting rising tensions between the US and Iran during this period.

title: Marcellus Young Casario's final moments revealed after sudden death at just 18
description: Marcellus Young Casario, an 18-year-old football player, died unexpectedly on November 13 due to a sudden medical incident. His family reported that he had felt unwell before going to sleep after getting water. An autopsy has been completed, but the family awaits toxicology results to understand the cause. His school, Rabun Gap-Nacoochee, and teammates mourn his loss while commemorating his contributions.

title: 14 years, 20 defeats — Fulham finally end Man City's dominance with a draw
description: Manchester City’s 14-year dominance over Fulham ended with a 1-1 draw at the Etihad, snapping the visitors’ 20-match losing streak against them. Rodrigo Muniz gave Fulham an early lead before Elliott Anderson rescued a point for City. The result extended City’s winless Premier League run to four matches, leaving them third, five points behind leaders Arsenal.

title: IB officer shot at by driver inside Haridwar office
description: A disturbing shooting took place in Kankhal, Haridwar, where SP CP Nautiyal, an officer with the Intelligence Bureau, was attacked by his hired driver, Vinod Negi, who was quickly apprehended. The officer has been admitted to the hospital and is said to be in stable condition. Investigations are underway to uncover the motive for the shooting, with no prior offenses linked to Negi being reported.

title: Trump's dream of battleships turns into financial nightmare for US Navy
description: The US Navy's ambitious intention to introduce Trump-class battleships is likely to significantly inflate shipbuilding costs, currently projected at around $275 billion. This initiative aims to boost the fleet from 286 to 398 vessels by 2056, but has sparked concern over funding viability. Additionally, prolonged ship deployments are exerting pressure on operational capabilities and personnel, complicating the Navy's goal of sustaining a global presence amid rising financial and logistical hurdles.

title: 'Working to curb India’s rise': US report flags China's support to Pak during Op Sindoor
description: In May 2025, China's military support for Pakistan intensified India's security dilemmas. This report reveals Beijing's ongoing strategies aimed at stifling India's strategic advancements through both military and economic tactics. With Pakistan receiving advanced weaponry, India's concerns over a dual-threat scenario have been amplified. The evolving military alliance between China and Pakistan poses greater risks for India moving forward, showcasing a troubling shift in regional security dynamics.

title: 'Make history by winning three titles in a row': RCB head coach ahead of IPL 2027
description: As the IPL 2027 auction approaches, Royal Challengers Bengaluru is focused on keeping its successful squad intact. Coach Andy Flower is optimistic about retaining their key players, ensuring they remain contenders for the title. Meanwhile, Gujarat Titans have released Ishant Sharma, eyeing Harshal Patel as his potential replacement. Kolkata Knight Riders are also making moves to strengthen their batting, building on a robust bowling display last season.

title: VHP seeks ban on Ramayana: 'Historical events are fabricated'
description: Vishva Hindu Parishad has raised objections against the film 'Ramayana', claiming it distorts elements of the epic. The organization accuses the film's makers of fabricating incidents and omitting key characters. Allegations include the film's portrayal of Ravana as a liberator of certain communities, which they find problematic. Critics argue that essential messages of the Ramayana are not depicted in the film's narrative.

MEA clears Taj Mahal visit for Pak delegation, no nod for Nizamuddin dargah
description: A Pakistani delegation, led by Musadik Masood Malik, is in India for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum. They have been permitted to visit the Taj Mahal, Humayun's Tomb, and Dilli Haat. However, their visit to Nizamuddin dargah has not been security cleared. This visit marks the first by a Pakistani minister to India in three years. The programme emphasizes shared civilizational heritage and cross-cultural engagement among SCO member countries.

title: 'India not a rogue state': Wangchuk says 'house arrest' lifted after court hearing
description: Sonam Wangchuk accused the Ladakh administration of effectively placing him under house arrest since November 11. He appealed to President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi to uphold constitutional values. Wangchuk expressed concerns about government misuse of police for actions that compromise their duties. He opposed the timing of Hill Council elections, arguing that many residents would be unable to participate.

title: New UFO files reveal Pentagon's plan for secret underground vault to keep 'exotic' material
description: In a recent release, the Pentagon unveiled a treasure trove of documents on UFO investigations dating as far back as the 1950s. The files contain thrilling accounts of unidentified aerial phenomena witnessed by both military personnel and civilians worldwide. One standout account includes Clarence 'Kelly' Johnson spotting a peculiar object in California in 1953. Additionally, military encounters like the USS Nimitz incident from 2004 are documented.

title: Big blow for Bangladesh! Star player ruled out of second Test against SA
description: Bangladesh is set to clash with South Africa in the second Test at Centurion on November 23. Unfortunately, veteran batter Mushfiqur Rahim will miss the game due to a groin injury incurred in the first Test, confirmed by an MRI showing pelvic inflammation. In a surprising turn, South Africa's captain Temba Bavuma will also be sidelined with a calf strain, leading Aiden Markram to step in as captain.

title: Trump throws Miller into 2028 presidential race, leaves Vance and Rubio stunned
description: During a White House press briefing, Donald Trump jokingly suggested White House aide Stephen Miller could run for president. This remark took place in front of Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, both considered potential candidates for 2028. Trump avoided directly answering which of them he preferred as his successor when questioned.

title: 'My parents came from India': Nikhil's emotional Player of the Match moment at MCG
description: Nikhil Chaudhary delivered a match-winning performance in his first T20I against England at the MCG. He scored 66 runs off 38 balls and took two wickets for 21 runs. His parents, who traveled from India, watched him play live for the first time. The all-rounder expressed his joy about receiving the Player of the Match award in front of them.

title: 17-year-old girl strangled, stabbed to death by boyfriend over talking to other boys
description: In Tuticorin, a 17-year-old girl named Abarna was killed by her boyfriend Muthuraj during an argument. The altercation arose when he insisted she stop talking to other boys. After the attack, Muthuraj attempted suicide by slashing his wrist and consuming poison. Police apprehended him and provided medical treatment at Thoothukudi Government Hospital. Investigations into the incident are currently ongoing to gather more information.

title: Man harasses woman at Karnataka hospital; flees after she screams, slaps him
description: In a troubling incident at the district hospital, a woman attendant was allegedly harassed by an intruder early in the morning while she was tending to a patient and resting nearby. The man managed to enter the ward unnoticed, raising serious security alarms, especially after reports of over ten mobile phones and cash being stolen from attendants recently.

Hong Kong Open: Lakshya Sen's title hat-trick bid ends, Satwik-Chirag also crash out
description: In a disappointing turn at the Hong Kong Open Super 500, India's Lakshya Sen and the men's doubles team were knocked out in the semifinals. Lakshya lost decisively to Anders Antonsen from Denmark, with the match concluding at 21-13, 21-13. Meanwhile, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty fought valiantly but were edged out by the Malaysian team. Despite promising performances in previous tournaments, this time India couldn't secure a spot in the finals.

title: Putin 'ready' to accept Nato-like shield for Ukraine, but with a catch
description: Russia has shown a potential openness to explore security guarantees for Ukraine, inspired by NATO's framework. This could enable Ukraine to gain necessary protections while allowing Moscow to maintain its control over specific occupied lands. According to US special envoy Jared Kushner, productive discussions in Berlin have made this agreement more achievable. A ceasefire along existing front lines is essential to pave the way for a lasting peace agreement.

title: Bihar redux in UP: Can Priyanka deliver for Rahul again in Cong-SP number game?
description: Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi are negotiating a seat-sharing arrangement for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. The Samajwadi Party and Congress, both part of the INDIA alliance, are facing tensions over seat allocations. Previous experiences in Bihar are influencing their current discussions as both parties seek to avoid a repeat of past mistakes. Congress has shown willingness to compromise while maintaining its demands.

title: Bullets rain, helicopter chase, explosion: Mexico's dramatic drug lord hunt; watch
'We all made mistakes': Lehmann reveals 'dark place' after Sandpapergate scandal
description: Darren Lehmann firmly states he was unaware of the ball-tampering scheme that emerged during the contentious 2018 tour in South Africa. He reflects on the heavy personal consequences of the scandal while accepting his role as coach. With Usman Khawaja's recent remarks reigniting discussions, Lehmann reiterates his stance, highlighting the emotional ramifications of the incident and expressing sympathy for those involved.

title: 'Turns a blind eye': BJP takes swipe at Rahul as Trump hails India's GDP growth
description: In a recent statement, Donald Trump praised India's impressive GDP growth while taking the Federal Reserve to task for its high interest rates. He opined that reducing these rates could spur US economic growth by 15 to 20 percent. Trump's advocacy for a stronger economy aligns with BJP leader Ashish Sood's approval of India's fiscal achievements, contrasting his earlier critiques of Indian trade policies from July 2025.

title: Shubman Gill joins Gambhir, Ganguly and Laxman in unwanted Indian Test record
description: Shubman Gill showcased his batting prowess with a near-century, scoring 98 runs during the opening Test at Basin Reserve against New Zealand. This performance places him among distinguished Indian cricketers with four Test dismissals in the 90s. With India's batting bolstered by Rishabh Pant's solid 55 not out, the team carries a substantial 118-run advantage into the crucial fourth day of play.

title: Satya Nadella praises Jensen Huang but makes it clear that tech founders are not gods
description: Satya Nadella highlighted the significant impact of founders in the tech world, emphasizing their human characteristics rather than any mythical traits. He commended Jensen Huang for successfully transforming Nvidia into a robust organization capable of flourishing autonomously after the founder's exit. Nadella pointed out that true leadership is measured by an institution’s resilience. He expressed his admiration for Huang's lasting contributions to the technology sector.

title: As Florida uses robot rabbits to catch pythons; study reveals when snakes climb trees
description: In 2025, Florida implemented solar-powered robotic rabbit decoys designed to attract Burmese pythons for removal efforts. Researchers tracked 346 pythons from 2017 to 2024 to study their climbing behavior. The study found that juvenile pythons are more likely to climb trees compared to adults. A recent competition in 2026 resulted in 280 pythons being removed by participants. Since 2017, over 19,000 pythons have been captured in Florida through organized efforts.

title: Travis Kelce's mom Donna Kelce opens up about living alone and life without sons
description: Donna Kelce has opened up about living alone in Florida while her sons, Jason and Travis, manage demanding careers and busy personal lives. In an interview with Architectural Digest, she admitted she sometimes has no idea which city they are visiting. Despite the distance, Donna says her sons are always on her mind. She fills her days with simple routines and photographs that remind her of family memories.

title: Why India still needs tanks in the age of drones, explained by the man who ran its nukes
